map.估算光伏面板在一段时间内的发电量。: Estimate the generation of a PV panel over a period.
map.E = 面积 × 效率 × 日均辐照 × 天数: E = area × efficiency × daily irradiation × days
map.实际受倾角、遮挡、温度影响。: In practice it is affected by tilt, shading and temperature.
map.电站测算：录入装机与资源区等效小时，估年发电与收益。: Plant estimate: enter the installed capacity and the equivalent hours for the resource zone to estimate annual generation and revenue.
map.收益评估：对自发自用/余电上网录入电价，算回收期。: Return assessment: enter the tariff for self-consumption or surplus feed-in to calculate the payback period.
map.教学演示：演示倾角与朝向对等效小时的影响。: Teaching demo: show how tilt and orientation affect the equivalent hours.
Example: 5 kW with 1100 equivalent hours and a performance ratio of 0.82 gives annual generation ≈ 5×1100×0.82 = 4510 kWh.
map.等效小时哪来？: Where do the equivalent hours come from?
map.由当地辐射与系统损失折算（如三类区约 1000–1300 h），查资源图谱。结果: They are derived from local irradiation and system losses (about 1000–1300 h in a class-III zone); consult a solar resource map. Results are estimated according to public standards and environmental factors, for science outreach, teaching and emission-reduction estimates; actual accounting should follow official guidelines (such as the GHG Protocol and provincial carbon emission factors) and measured data.
map.性能比含什么？: What does the performance ratio include?
map.组件衰降、温度、线损、逆变与遮挡损失，乘 0.75–0.85 得实际。结果按公开: Module degradation, temperature, line losses, inverter losses and shading, so multiply by 0.75–0.85 to obtain the actual figure. Results are estimated according to public standards and environmental factors, for science outreach, teaching and emission-reduction estimates; actual accounting should follow official guidelines (such as the GHG Protocol and provincial carbon emission factors) and measured data.
map.和光伏减排关系？: What is the relation to PV emission reduction?
map.发电量×电网因子即减排，见光伏减排工具，二者同源。结果按公开标准与环境因子估算，: Generation × grid factor gives the reduction, as in the PV emission reduction tool; the two share the same basis. Results are estimated according to public standards and environmental factors, for science outreach, teaching and emission-reduction estimates; actual accounting should follow official guidelines (such as the GHG Protocol and provincial carbon emission factors) and measured data.
